---
title: "Overall survival: survival rates"
subtitle: "Survival probabilities and risk differences at 182 and 365 days"
format: html
---

- Day 182 from the main OS models; day 365 from the unrestricted-follow-up PH models.
- Risk difference $S^1(t)-S^0(t)$; positive favours ctDNA.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(ggdist)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "08-survival-rates", "results"
)
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Survival at each horizon

```{r}
#| label: survival-draws
#| include: false

main_curves <- read_parquet(here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results",
  "survival-curves.parquet"
))

unrestricted_curves <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting) |>
  map(\(index) {
    read_parquet(here(
      "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "04-unrestricted-follow-up",
      "results", "ph", "survival-curves",
      sprintf("survival-365-%02d.parquet", index)
    ))
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

rate_draws <- bind_rows(
  survival_risk_draws(main_curves, horizon = 182) |>
    mutate(horizon_days = 182L, model = "Primary adjusted OS"),
  survival_risk_draws(unrestricted_curves, horizon = 365) |>
    mutate(horizon_days = 365L, model = "Unrestricted adjusted PH OS")
)

# Both arms present, and every imputation contributes equally many draws.
stopifnot("imputation" %in% names(rate_draws), setequal(rate_draws$tx, 0:1))
equal_draw_counts <- rate_draws |>
  count(horizon_days, imputation, tx) |>
  summarise(equal = n_distinct(n) == 1L, .by = horizon_days) |>
  pull(equal)
stopifnot(all(equal_draw_counts))
```

## Risk differences and summaries

```{r}
#| label: summaries
#| include: false

contrast_draws <- rate_draws |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tx,
    values_from = survival,
    names_prefix = "survival_"
  ) |>
  mutate(risk_difference = survival_1 - survival_0)

stopifnot(!anyNA(contrast_draws))

rate_summary <- rate_draws |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower_95 = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper_95 = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(horizon_days, model, tx)
  )

contrast_summary <- contrast_draws |>
  summarise(
    median = median(risk_difference),
    lower_66 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    upper_66 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    lower_95 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper_95 = quantile(risk_difference, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(risk_difference > 0),
    imputations = n_distinct(imputation),
    draws_per_imputation = n() / n_distinct(imputation),
    .by = c(horizon_days, model)
  )

write_parquet(rate_summary, file.path(results_dir, "rates-summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(contrast_summary, file.path(results_dir, "summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(contrast_draws, file.path(results_dir, "estimand-draws.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-survival-risk-difference-posterior
#| fig-cap: "Posterior survival risk differences at 182 and 365 days. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "Posterior half-eye densities and dot plots of ctDNA-minus-usual-care survival differences at two horizons, with a zero reference line. Positive differences favour invitation."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7
#| echo: false

risk_difference_plot <- contrast_draws |>
  transmute(
    draw = 100 * risk_difference,
    panel = factor(
      horizon_days,
      levels = c(182, 365),
      labels = c(
        "Day 182: primary adjusted OS",
        "Day 365: unrestricted adjusted PH OS"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  plot_posterior(
    x_label = "Survival risk difference (ctDNA − usual care), percentage points"
  )

save_figure(
  risk_difference_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "survival-risk-difference-posterior.png"),
  height = 7
)

risk_difference_plot
```
